name: core-reactions-changes
description: Reactions' changes (D56): a rule fires when a create, an update or an operation of the instance moves a field's value, an own field or a behavior's by qualified name with a member path after it, to to and from from when they are given. A create moves a field from absent and a delete moves nothing. A value the event keeps in the value store is compared once loaded, a rule on the instance itself acts only while the field still holds to, and changes rules on Workflow.status chain, to the runner's depth limit, and join enters rules' cycle check. parseConfig refuses an unknown field, a volatile one and Workflow.enteredAt.

namespace.description: The namespace that holds the instance

schemaNamespace.description: The namespace that holds the schema

version.description: The schema version the instance was last written with

seq.description: The sequence of the instance's last event: its entity tag

behaviors.description: The instance's behaviors' fields, by behavior name, apart from its own fields

status.description: The state the instance is in.

enteredAt.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

commentCount.description: How many comments the instance has.

valueRefs.description: For a read with valueRefs: the JSON pointers into data of the fields that hold a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, in place of a value the value store holds

scenarios.name: Reactions' changes (node) > an own field: a create moves it from absent, an update that moves it fires, and one that leaves it fires nothing
Reactions' changes (node) > from and to: only a move from the one value to the other fires, and a create moves a field from no value
Reactions' changes (node) > a behavior's field: Workflow.status as enters hears it, and Comments.commentCount moving from 0, the operation's patch read as a diff
Reactions' changes (node) > a delete moves nothing
Reactions' changes (node) > a member path below a behavior field whose value is an object, the behavior the longest name that prefixes it
Reactions' changes (node) > a value the event keeps in the value store is compared once loaded, never as its ref
Reactions' changes (node) > a rule with to on the instance itself acts only while the field still holds it; one through a link does not ask
Reactions' changes (node) > rules on Workflow.status chain on the instance itself, each move one deeper, and stop at the depth limit
Reactions' changes (node) > guidance names each changes rule, and the writes that can set one off say the status may move after the commit

behaviors.name: Workflow
behaviors.description: A state machine on the instance: a status that starts in the initial state and changes only through transition, along a transition the config lists. A transition may name a permission the caller must hold. A state that no transition leaves is terminal, and a terminal state has an outcome: success, failure or neutral, success unless the config says otherwise. Other instances' blockers, rollups and reactions read it.
behaviors.summary: Its status is one of new, triaged, escalated and closed; a new Ticket starts in new, and status moves only by transition. Terminal, with their outcomes: closed (success).

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: enteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

vetoes.description: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
No transition of the config leads from the instance's state to the one named.
The instance has no status to move from.

behaviors.name: Comments
behaviors.description: Comments on the instance, each a reply to another or not. A caller who may write the instance adds one; a caller who may read it lists them. Deleting the instance deletes its comments.
behaviors.summary: Each Ticket holds a thread of comments, each one a reply to another of its comments or not; commentCount counts them.

fields.name: commentCount
fields.description: How many comments the instance has.

behaviors.name: Reactions
behaviors.description: Rules that move Workflow statuses after a change commits: when the instance's status enters a state, when a field of the instance, its own or a behavior's, changes, when every instance that links to it through a link is in a terminal state, optionally one with a listed outcome, when one of them enters a terminal state with a listed outcome, when an all or any rollup of the instance comes to hold, or when the instance one of its links points to gains a revision or a release, move the instance, or the instance one of its links points to, to a state. An engine runs them after the commit, as the principal it names for its runner, so a rule never refuses the change that set it off. A target already in the state, with no transition to it, or whose guards refuse is left as it is.
behaviors.summary: After a change commits, the runner moves statuses by rules, through transition and its guards: when priority changes to "urgent", it moves to escalated; when Comments.commentCount changes from 0, it moves to triaged. A move a guard vetoes, or that no transition allows, is left undone.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Ticket
operations.description: Creates a Ticket: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

id.description: The instance id; the engine makes one when it is absent

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Ticket: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. A new instance's status is new. Reactions' rules on Ticket may move it, or the instances it links to, again after the commit.

operations.name: get
operations.title: Get Ticket
operations.description: Returns the Ticket with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Ticket to read.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Ticket instances; call list.
guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Ticket
operations.description: Lists Ticket instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

anyOf.description: The state the instance is in.

items.description: The state the instance is in.

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Ticket instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title, priority, body or Workflow.status; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's. where: { "Workflow.status": <state> } lists the instances in one of new, triaged, escalated or closed, and a list of states the instances in any of them.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Ticket
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Ticket with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Ticket

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Ticket with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not use to move Workflow's status, which behaviors.Workflow holds; call transition.
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq. Reactions' rules on Ticket may move it, or the instances it links to, again after the commit.

operations.name: delete
operations.title: Delete Ticket
operations.description: Deletes the Ticket with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Ticket with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

operations.name: transition
operations.title: Ticket: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

from.description: The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.

guidance.useWhen: Use to move status from new to triaged or escalated; from triaged to escalated or closed; from escalated to triaged or closed.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use from closed: no transition leaves a terminal state. Do not use to stay where the instance is.
guidance.success: Returns from and to; status holds to from then on, and enteredAt the time of the move. Reactions' rules on Ticket may move it, or the instances it links to, again after the commit.

errors.description: Workflow: No transition leads from the instance's status to the state named; details.allowed lists the states it can move to.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status, then name a state details.allowed lists, or move through one of them first.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status: the instance is already there, so nothing needs to move.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
errors.commonCorrection: None: the work has ended. Create a new instance to start again.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance has no status to move from.
errors.commonCorrection: None: an instance without a status cannot move.

operations.name: comment
operations.title: Ticket: comment
operations.description: Adds a comment to the instance, or a reply to one of its comments.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

replyTo.description: The id of the instance's comment this one replies to.

createdBy.description: The subject of the caller who added it.

id.description: The comment's number on the instance: 1, 2, 3, ...

replyTo.description: The id of the comment it replies to.

guidance.useWhen: Use to add a comment to the instance, or with replyTo a reply to one of the instance's comments.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change the instance's fields; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the comment with its id, which a reply names as replyTo; commentCount grows by one. Reactions' rules on Ticket may move it, or the instances it links to, again after the commit.

operations.name: listComments
operations.title: Ticket: listComments
operations.description: Lists the instance's comments, oldest first, one page at a time.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many comments; 50 when absent.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

guidance.useWhen: Use to read the instance's comments, oldest first, a page at a time.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.
